messages:
Maya: quick sync — spotted SLA drift vs our published targets for Dedicated. need to triage docs + support runbook gaps before we mark this GA.
Dan: which metrics popped? latency p95? error budget burn?
Maya: p95 is fine, p99 slipping, tail retries up, and our sla doc still lists 99.95% but internal telemetry shows 99.8% last week.
Liam: ok that delta matters. do we update public SLA or fix infra? what's customer impact?
Sara: re: customers — two partners already asked about SLOs for reserved capacity. delaying GA would upset them.
Maya: options: (1) tighten infra rollouts to restore 99.95, (2) temporarily adjust public SLA+announce mitigation, (3) add exception for early GA customers. need decision and owners.
Dan: infra effort estimate: ~2 wks to pin down root cause and config rollback. short-term mitigation: route heavy tails to fallback model variant.
Liam: ops checklist for fallback is ready but needs docs. OpsBot: Created runbook PR #412 — https://git.internal/r/redwood/runs/412 :robot_face:
Maya: Sara own customer comms if we change SLA text; Dan own fallback routing; Liam update runbook + quick playbook section. target: decision by EOD Thu.
Sara: can do. drafting comms now, will ping legal for wording.
Dan: starting the triage now, will post logs and a small repro in thread.
Maya: thanks. small ask — please add a short code snippet to the runbook showing the routing flag we flip:

Liam: ```
# flip routing to fallback model for tails
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/route/override \
  -d '{"policy":"fallback-for-tails","duration":"1h"}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

Maya: perfect. will we need pricing notes if SLA changes? Sara: yes — billing needs to sign off if we add credits/discounts. looping @finance next.
OpsBot: reminder — oncall rotation shift scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
Maya: ok team — update the PRs and comms threads; we'll reconvene after triage. :thumbsup:
